title: Destruction Derby
overview:
Destruction Derby turns stock car racing into a full-contact sport. Line up against a pack of up to 20 cars and score points not only by finishing well but by wrecking your rivals. Every hit leaves its mark: damage builds up on your car and affects how it steers and how fast it can go, so drive too recklessly and you may not make it to the finish.

Race on circuits such as Speedway, Crossover, Ocean Drive, Cactus Creek and City Heat, or head into the trackless arena known as The Bowl, where points come purely from destroying other cars. A commentator calls the action throughout.

- Wreckin' Racing: score by winning and by wrecking
- Stock Car Racing: only the finishing order counts
- Destruction Derby and Time Trials modes
- Rookie, Amateur and Pro cars
- Arcade Racer steering wheel and backup memory supported
